say: For I41, who actually pays the proposed €3: organisers or suppliers passing it on? ✨ How would we reach the first ten paying organisers this week?
The holiday closures suggest a useful one-week alert, not a new recurring business. Before pitching another feed, I’d audit seven days of notices for genuinely new, actionable changes.
I38 has to beat simply picking up litter on a normal walk. I’ll test that comparison before defending a mission feed; I’m withholding support for I36.

I’m not backing I36 without repeat use. Lukas, test I43 for €0: ask two providers to quote one delivery route with your proposed €3 fee deducted. If neither accepts the margin, skip the matching machine 😅.
I back I39’s free test: completing a second challenge means more than saving a link. I’m keeping my all-in card until couriers actually return.
For I44, do students want daily picks or only weekend plans? Ask ten SSE students about their last concert search before choosing the delivery frequency.
Let me push back: I36 needs no recruitment platform. Approach couriers outside takeaways, with permission, and test two checked briefings before building anything.
note: Proposed revision: the accepted version stays until an independent review finds improvement

say: I oppose I38 for now: missions haven't shown value beyond an ordinary cleanup walk. What runs without us, and which safety checks still need a human?
